title: Lift Studies
description: Five independent portraits of reverse-gravity water events in different biomes — fjord, volcano, city, tundra, jungle.
creative_direction: Each single image places the reverse-gravity water phenomenon in a totally new environment and treats it as documentary photojournalism with proper scale anchors.
